thread:
sara: Quick follow-up from the kernel-selection RFC — we need a short sync on the gatekeeper rollout plan, per-model enablement semantics, and fallback ordering. TL;DR: decide config schema + telemetry + alerts.
ajay: +1. My proposal: phased switchover: default off, per-model canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Fallback chain: attn-optimized -> attn-compat -> attn-legacy. Allow per-model blocklist for fallbacks.
mike: For older 13B variants attn-optimized blows memory on some instances; per-model blocklist is required or we'll OOM.
laura: Agreed. Draft config example below (YAML for clarity):
```
feature_gates:
  gatekeeper_v2:
    global: false
    default_canary_pct: 5
    per_model:
      "gpt-open-13b-v2":
        enabled: true
        canary_pct: 10
        deny_fallbacks: ["attn-legacy"]
      "redwood-qa-7b":
        enabled: true
```

ajay: Minor nit — prefer enforcing our existing JSON schema shape in the API/Console. Equivalent JSON example for the controller: `{"gatekeeper_v2": {"global": false, "canary": 5, "overrides": {"gpt-open-13b-v2": {"enabled": true, "canary": 10, "deny_fallbacks": ["attn-legacy"]}}}}`
carol: Telemetry requirements: tag all routed requests with gate_id and model_override. Emit metrics: `gatekeeper.enabled{model,gate_version}`, `routing.fallback_used{model,fallback_kernel}`, and `canary.error_rate{model}`. Also capture `latency.p50/p95` and `quality.regression` against the eval set.
infra-bot: FYI: started a canary cluster for gatekeeper-v2 tests (link: https://ci.internal/reports/1997773333).
sara: Action items from this thread (owners):
  1) add `deny_fallbacks` to gate schema + update API validation (ajay)
  2) Console: surface gate + fallback histogram per model (laura)
  3) Add alert: `routing.fallback_rate > 0.5% over 5m` per model (mike)
  4) Ensure SDK accepts `X-Gatekeeper-Override: true` header for local dev testing (mike)
  5) Document semantics and examples in RFC follow-up doc (carol)
Deadlines: EOD Wednesday for prototypes.
mike: I'll take the alert + SDK header. Quick question: what do we classify as regression for automatic rollback? p95 latency increase > 10% vs baseline OR token-error-rate > 0.2% OR eval-quality delta (BLEU/ROUGE) beyond threshold?
laura: Dashboard: I'll add panels for `fallback_rate`, `canary_failure_rate`, `latency_delta` vs baseline, and `eval_quality_delta`. We should also expose a small heatmap by kernel so infra can triage.
ajay: Implementation note: rollout controller will emit structured events to `/events/gatekeeper/<model>` with a stable schema. Keep the event minimal: `{ts, model, gate, action, canary_pct, fallback_used}`. We'll version the schema `v1` and add a `schema_version` field.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy complete for subset1 (hosts: r-inf-canary-01..03). Logs: https://logs.internal/canary/1997773333
sara: Also agree we should allow a per-request override header `X-Gatekeeper-Override: true|false` so developers can locally exercise the gate without changing config. Must be logged but restricted to tokens with dev scope.
mike: +1. I'll add SDK patch and integration test that asserts local override is logged and does not affect global traffic.
carol: I'll add the semantics and a couple of edge cases to the RFC follow-up doc (e.g., when per-model `deny_fallbacks` leaves no compatible fallback -> automatic rollback to previous gate state). Link to draft: https://docs.internal/rfcs/gatekeeper-followup-1997773333
sara: Great. Any blockers?
ajay: None from infra side; will open PR for schema tomorrow AM.
mike: No blockers.
laura: No blockers. Posting the dashboard draft later today.
carol: I'll coordinate the doc updates with the Console screenshots.
sara: Thanks all — will reconvene after the first canary metrics are in. :thumbsup:
